description: This file defines the CandidateHistoryDefaultModel class in the OrangeHRM recruitment API module. It models a candidate's history data, including related entities such as candidate personal info, vacancy details, hiring manager information, and action metadata. The class implements normalization functionalities for API serialization.

classes.name: CandidateHistoryDefaultModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing candidate history data in the recruitment API, implementing normalizable serialization and defining attribute filters for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a CandidateHistory entity and sets attribute filters and names for serialization.
